newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to down 0.05.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open flat to down 0.05.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open unchanged to 0.05 cent weaker Tuesday, dealers said.

The spot July contract is expected to ease as speculators roll out of July positions ahead of expiry on June 30. Traders said the July/October spread should narrow to about 0.05 cent July premium, by the end of the week.
The spread stood at 0.08 cent July premium on Monday.
Yesterday spot July closed 0.06 cent lower at 11.36 cents a lb, with most-active October 0.04 cent lower at 11.28 cents and the rest 0.05 to 0.01 cent weaker.
LIFFE white sugar futures were weaker on Tuesday amid thin volume. At 0842 EDT/1242, spot August stood $1.60 weaker at $322.00, while the back months were trading $1.00 to $0.50 lower.
